prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style educational asset graphic. A side-by-side lineup of three distinct sauropod eggs arranged neatly on a flat, neutral light-grey studio floor. STUDIO_GROUNDED lighting with crisp, dark contact shadows directly underneath each object to give them a heavy physical weight. Perfectly centered 1:1 square composition, formatted as a square hero card with a strict 25% negative space buffer on all four outer boundaries. style_notes: SQUARE_HERO_CARD, STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3. Ensure the aspect ratio is exactly 1:1. Only one horizontal scale bar at the very bottom edge. All items must stay within the central power-zone grid without touching the frame limits.
